policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 25:24 renders the phrase as "a contentious woman" with no note attached to this unit. Qere מִדְיָנִים and ketiv מדונים are alternate spellings of the same noun of strife, and both yield exactly that English; the ASV wording, which supplies no italics and no textual note here, therefore distinguishes neither. Underdetermined; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
